entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I assist you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor. Your website is giving me some error about a return window, and I want my money back. Now.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. I can definitely look into that for you. May I have your order number, please?
It's VF-8675309. And you'd better fix this. I've had a horrible month and I am not in the mood for a runaround.

I understand. Thank you for that. Pulling it up now... I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor was delivered on December 18th, which was 25 days ago. To make sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

The issue is I was in the HOSPITAL! I had a major medical emergency right after this thing arrived and needed to have surgery. The last thing on my mind was your gadget. This is the first chance I've had to even look at the box. I don't care if it works or not, I can't use it now and I want a refund.

Oh my, I am very sorry to hear about your surgery. I truly hope you are on the road to a full recovery. I completely understand why this wasn't a priority. Please allow me to check our return policy details for you, one moment.

You do that. Because if you tell me I'm out of luck after a medical emergency, I'm going straight to my credit card company and then to every review site on the internet. And I want your manager's name.

I understand your frustration, and I assure you I'll do everything I can. Okay, I've just consulted our internal knowledge base... and it looks like you have nothing to worry about. The information on the website must have been confusing. Our policy clearly states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Ninety days? Seriously? The site was making it seem like I had 10 or 20 days. What kind of operation are you running?

My apologies for that discrepancy. I can see here that you're well within the 90-day timeframe. I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you right away. I'm generating a prepaid return label and sending it to the email we have on file.
Oh. Okay. Well, that's what should have happened in the first place. Fine. Send the label.

The email has just been sent. Simply print the label, attach it to the box, and drop it off with the courier. Once we receive the sensor at our warehouse, your refund will be issued within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish you a speedy recovery.
